dataformat.name: jsonApi
dataformat.title: JSonApi
dataformat.description: Marshal and unmarshal JSON:API resources using JSONAPI-Converter library
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation

marshalIn.description: One resource object of a class dataFormatTypes names, annotated with @Type and @Id of JSONAPI-Converter. A Map or a List fails

marshalOut.description: The JSON:API document in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

unmarshalOut.description: The primary data as an object of the class mainFormatType names, or no body when the data is null. A document whose data is an array fails

dataFormatTypes.description: The classes to take into account for the marshalling. Multiple classes can be separated by comma.

mainFormatType.description: The class to take into account while unmarshalling.
